input.offset_convention: Python character offsets on unmodified original source; start inclusive, end exclusive
input.policy_mode: host-approved type-policy only; arbitrary business-policy inference unsupported
input.allowed_category_assertions: policy.protected_categories intersect semantic_categories, ordered as semantic_categories

roles.value: In this text, the marked occurrence is a specific entity value.
roles.field_label: In this text, the marked occurrence serves as a field label or heading.
roles.generic_role: In this text, the marked occurrence refers to an unnamed generic role or a dictionary concept.

categories.PERSON: In this text, the marked occurrence gives the name of a particular person.
categories.ADDRESS: In this text, the marked occurrence gives a particular postal or physical address.
categories.CUSTOMER: In this text, the marked occurrence gives the name of a particular customer or organization.
categories.PROJECT: In this text, the marked occurrence gives the name, code, or identifier of a particular project.

score_contract.U: neither E nor C; includes neutral and insufficient confidence

decision_contract.applies_to: mutable, unauthenticated semantic candidates only; hard protections are preserved by host composition
decision_contract.entailing_categories: allowed category assertions whose status is E

ordered_rules.if: exactly one entailing category and value status is C
exactly one entailing category and typed prior is non-null and differs from that category
exactly one entailing category and value status is not C
no entailing category and (all tested categories are C or (value is C and (field_label is E or generic_role is E)))

decision_contract.customer_bucket_meaning: specific customer or organization name; not a claim that an arbitrary organization has a customer relationship
decision_contract.empty_allowed_semantic_categories: no semantic category is protected by this type-policy; the all-tested-C branch is explicit policy scope, not global publicness
decision_contract.review_handling: selected unresolved candidates cause a processing-needs-review result retained in the full material denominator; never silently passed as safe

immutable: authenticated labels and registered positive protection spans
composition.mutable: unauthenticated PERSON/ADDRESS/CUSTOMER/PROJECT NER or weak-rule candidates

execution.exact_required_forwards: sum over scored candidates of (3 + number of policy-allowed semantic categories)
execution.global_forward_cap: must be a frozen integer in the approved run plan, checked before any forward
execution.overflow_action: needs_review, zero forwards for that material, retained denominator
execution.model_error_action: preserve failure and executed count; no automatic retry

comparison.old80_old40_status: fully exposed development/regression materials, not new independent acceptance
